raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `WrapperDispatch.SLIDING_WINDOW`, the FlashInfer backend plans two paged prefill wrappers (window /
full) but only one ragged wrapper, planned without a window. On a cold prefill (no cached prefix) with
the ragged path enabled, sliding-window layers go through that ragged wrapper:

- the `extend_no_prefix` branch calls `prefill_wrapper_ragged.forward(...)` with no `window_left`, so
  the layer attends the whole prompt;
- the prefix branch passes `window_left` at run time, but FlashInfer selects the kernel at plan time, so
  a run-time window on a wrapper planned without one does not mask.

Text-only models with sliding-window layers (multimodal models already disable ragged) therefore
compute full attention on those layers for prompts longer than the window. We found it serving a model
whose sliding-window output feeds a log-sum-exp merge: teacher-forced top-1 against the HF reference
dropped from ~99.97 % to 99.90 % on 6K-token prompts, with reference margins up to 1.5 at the
disagreeing positions; the fix restores bf16-tie level.

## Modifications

`use_ragged` is False under `WrapperDispatch.SLIDING_WINDOW`; those batches use the per-dispatch paged
wrappers, which are planned with `window_left`. Other dispatch modes are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

- New unit test `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_flashinfer_swa_ragged_prefill.py`: fails on
  main (ragged chosen under sliding-window dispatch), passes with the fix.
- Model-level effect as described above (6,000-token passage, 99.90 % -> 99.97 % top-1 vs HF).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Only sliding-window models on FlashInfer change: their cold prefills use the paged wrappers instead of
the ragged one. We have not yet measured prefill throughput before/after on a sliding-window model; we will add it here.

## Checklist

- [x] pre-commit
- [x] regression test (fails before, passes after)

## AI assistance

This change was developed with AI assistance (Claude Code). The tests and measurements reported here were
run by us on our own hardware, and we will follow up on review feedback.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

nodes.body:
Follow-up on the prefill-throughput TODO in the description. We measured it on Gemma-3-12B-it (text-only, sliding window 1024 on 5 of every 6 layers), FlashInfer backend, bf16, on a single GPU. Baseline is the nightly at b234b5c3, compared with the same tree plus this patch. The command was `python -m sglang.benchmark.one_batch --attention-backend flashinfer --batch-size 1 4 --input-len 2048 8192 12000 --output-len 4 --disable-radix-cache`. Each row is the median of 3 runs. Run-to-run spread was 2% or less.

| batch x input | before (tok/s) | after (tok/s) | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 x 2048  | 24,460 | 24,140 | -1.3% |
| 1 x 8192  | 22,880 | 23,970 | +4.8% |
| 1 x 12000 | 21,500 | 23,060 | +7.3% |
| 4 x 2048  | 25,560 | 24,660 | -3.5% |
| 4 x 8192  | 22,940 | 23,750 | +3.6% |
| 4 x 12000 | 21,480 | 23,030 | +7.2% |

Throughput goes up with prompt length because the sliding-window layers stop attending the full prompt. At 2K tokens the paged prefill path is slightly slower than the ragged one, because at that length the window saves little work.

The correctness side matters more than the speed. We teacher-forced a 12,000-token passage and compared top-1 next-token agreement against the triton backend (which applies the window correctly):

| | positions < 1023 | positions >= 1023 | mean abs dlogprob | KL (top-20) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | 98.34% | 17.05% | 8.34 | 2.89 |
| after | 98.24% | 98.73% | 0.055 | 3.0e-3 |

Without the patch, cold FlashInfer prefill on this model is wrong past the first window. With it, FlashInfer matches triton across the whole prompt.

If the 2K regression matters, we could keep the ragged path when the extend length is at most the window, since the result is identical in that case. We kept the patch minimal for now and are happy to add that if you prefer.

files.patch:
@@ -1019,6 +1019,12 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
                     not self.enable_deterministic
                     and not is_in_tc_piecewise_cuda_graph()
                     and not self.use_paged
+                    # The single ragged wrapper serves every layer and is planned
+                    # without a window; the window_left passed at run time does not
+                    # change the planned kernel, so sliding-window layers would
+                    # attend the whole prompt. Use the per-dispatch paged wrappers,
+                    # which are planned with the window.
+                    and self.dispatch_reason != WrapperDispatch.SLIDING_WINDOW
                 )
                 extend_no_prefix = not any(forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu)

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+"""FlashInfer extend metadata: sliding-window dispatch must not take the ragged prefill path.
+
+The ragged wrapper is shared by every layer and planned without a window, so a sliding-window
+layer served through it attends the whole prompt on a cold (no-prefix) prefill. The per-dispatch
+paged wrappers are planned with window_left and must be used instead.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import flashinfer_backend as fib
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _RecordingUpdater:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.use_ragged = None
+
+    def update(self, *args, use_ragged, **kwargs):
+        self.use_ragged = use_ragged
+
+
+def _backend(dispatch_reason):
+    backend = object.__new__(fib.FlashInferAttnBackend)
+    backend.use_sliding_window_kv_pool = False
+    backend.is_multimodal = False
+    backend.enable_mis = False
+    backend.enable_deterministic = False
+    backend.use_paged = False
+    backend.dispatch_reason = dispatch_reason
+    backend.indices_updater_prefill = _RecordingUpdater()
+    backend.prefill_wrappers_paged = [object(), object()]
+    backend.prefill_split_tile_size = None
+    backend.dq_page_table = None
+    backend._prepare_dequant_workspace_metadata_for_extend = lambda *args: None
+    return backend
+
+
+def _cold_extend_batch():
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+        out_cache_loc=None,
+        req_pool_indices=None,
+        seq_lens=None,
+        seq_lens_cpu=None,
+        seq_lens_sum=8,
+        extend_prefix_lens=None,
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu=[0],
+        encoder_lens=None,
+        cross_attention_custom_mask=None,
+        kv_loc_plan=None,
+    )
+
+
+class TestFlashInferSlidingWindowPrefill(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_sliding_window_dispatch_uses_paged_wrappers(self):
+        backend = _backend(fib.WrapperDispatch.SLIDING_WINDOW)
+        backend.init_forward_metadata(_cold_extend_batch())
+        self.assertFalse(backend.indices_updater_prefill.use_ragged)
+        self.assertFalse(backend.forward_metadata.use_ragged)
+
+    def test_other_dispatch_keeps_ragged(self):
+        for reason in (None, fib.WrapperDispatch.CROSS_ATTENTION):
+            backend = _backend(reason)
+            backend.init_forward_metadata(_cold_extend_batch())
+            self.assertTrue(backend.forward_metadata.use_ragged)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
